name: Ticket Enrichment — AI-Driven Incident Analysis
description: When a ServiceNow incident arrives via EDA, this workflow gathers diagnostics from the affected host, sends them to an AI agent for root cause analysis, and updates the incident with the findings.

incident_description.description: Combined short_description + description from the incident

parameters.prompt:
You are an expert Linux systems engineer. A ServiceNow incident has been raised and system diagnostics have been collected from the affected host. Incident: ${trigger.incident_number} Description: ${trigger.incident_description} Diagnostics: ${gather_diagnostics.artifacts.diagnostics_report} Analyse the diagnostics and provide: 1. Root Cause Analysis — what failed and why 2. Evidence — key log lines or indicators that support your conclusion 3. Remediation steps — specific commands or actions to resolve the issue 4. Prevention — how to stop this happening again IMPORTANT FORMATTING RULES: - Your response will be inserted into a ServiceNow work notes field. - Format your entire response as HTML. Do NOT use markdown. - Use

for section headings,

for paragraphs,

    /
      /
    • for lists. - Use for inline commands and file paths. - Use 
       for multi-line error output or log excerpts.
- Do NOT wrap the response in [code] tags — that will be added automatically.
- Keep the response concise and actionable.
